note: Optional archival research examples. These holdings do not assign the compiler a specific FRUS volume, topic, or date range. Source metadata is retained for provenance; no retrieved document contents are invented.

assignments.title: 1917–1972, Volume III, Public Diplomacy, World War II
assignments.task: Map wartime information-policy decisions and intended foreign audiences.
assignments.comparison: Separate the policy directive from the broadcast or leaflet used to carry it out.

assignments.title: 1917–1972, Volume IV, Public Diplomacy, 1945–1952
assignments.task: Prepare a source survey for the transition from wartime information work to postwar public diplomacy.
assignments.comparison: Keep a planning inventory distinct from a selected manuscript.

assignments.title: 1956–1960, The Intelligence Community
assignments.task: Trace the division between intelligence assessment, coordination, and presidential authorization.
assignments.comparison: An assessment is evidence of analysis, not proof that a policy was approved.

assignments.title: 1981–1988, Volume XLII, Refugees and Immigration, 1975–1984
assignments.task: Survey Kennedy-era refugee-policy records and preserve their original dates.
assignments.comparison: Explain how an earlier precedent relates to a later decision without confusing their dates.
assignments.selection: dated lead with its research relevance explained

assignments.title: 1981–1988, Volume XLII, Refugees and Immigration, 1975–1984
assignments.task: Survey Johnson-era immigration-policy records and trace their policy context.
assignments.comparison: Distinguish earlier statutory context from later implementation decisions.
assignments.selection: background context with an explicit date limit

assignments.title: 1969–1976, Volume E–10, Documents on American Republics, 1969–1972
assignments.task: Trace the Uruguay records and distinguish access from clearance.
assignments.comparison: A related published record does not establish that another record has been released.
assignments.selection: Uruguay source trail and unresolved clearance

assignments.title: 1981–1988, Volume XLII, Refugees and Immigration, 1975–1984
assignments.task: Investigate the 1975 refugee response across administrations.
assignments.comparison: Follow decisions across evacuation, admission, and resettlement; retain agency disagreements.

assignments.title: 1977–1980, Volume X, Iran: Revolution, January 1977–November 1979
assignments.task: Verify the source trail and chronology for policy toward revolutionary Iran.
assignments.comparison: Preserve the records’ dates; distinguish unresolved clearance from research availability.
assignments.selection: dated source note and clearance flag

assignments.title: 1981–1988, Volume VIII, Western Europe, 1985–1988
assignments.task: Follow the February 1985 Thatcher visit into the wider Western Europe decision record.
assignments.comparison: Separate a visit folder from a verified account of what the leaders decided.
assignments.selection: visit lead plus a request for decision records and State reporting

assignments.title: 1989–1992, Volume IV, Soviet Union, Russia, and Post-Soviet States: Policy
assignments.topic: NSC policy formation and source coverage
assignments.task: Use Rice’s NSC staff files to trace policy formation; coordinate the arms-control overlap.
assignments.comparison: Keep staff advice distinct from a presidential decision and from high-level meeting records.
assignments.selection: staff-file lead with separate decision and agency follow-up requests

assignments.title: 1993–2000, Volume XVIII, Russia: High-Level Contacts
assignments.task: Build a high-level contacts chronology from Clinton–Yeltsin memcons and telcons.
assignments.comparison: Keep conversation dates distinct from preparation dates and preserve each record’s form.
assignments.selection: dated memcon/telcon leads with a gap register for the rest of 1993–2000

assignments.title: 2001–2008, Volume XLIII, China, 2001–2004
assignments.task: Trace the EP-3 response without substituting public messaging for the decision record.
assignments.comparison: Distinguish press guidance, draft statements, bulletins and email from final policy instructions.
assignments.selection: NSC electronic-record leads, a document-type register and explicit access gaps
